Detailed Description

Interface for loading bot data from an abstract source.

Implementations provide the concrete I/O strategy (e.g., local filesystem, in-memory assets).

Note
See FileBotLoader and SuperDexStudioBotLoader for file- and memory-based examples, respectively.
Pass an IBotLoader to superdex::robotics::LoadBotPrefab to control how files and shapes are resolved.
